summary: Following the WHO Information Notice for IVD Users 2026/01, The Global Fund issued a Quality Assurance Information Notice (No 2025‑89) on 28 May 2026 suspending the WHO pre‑qualification status of all in‑vitro diagnostic medical devices manufactured by Meril Diagnostics Pvt. Ltd., affecting all batches of the listed products worldwide. No additional national regulator or WHO alerts beyond this Global Fund notice were identified in the searched sources.
